title: Lavonte David: The Bucs "kind of like sh-t the bed" in 2025

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lavonte David: The Bucs "kind of like sh-t the bed" in 2025
sources.description: The Buccaneers, at 6-2 through eight weeks, seemed to be destined to win their fifth straight NFC South crown, and to make it to the playoffs for the sixth consecutive season.
